title: Modeling and shading realistic eyes in Blender

queue.claim: In Blender Cycles, MNEE shadow caustics (Blender 3.2+) are enabled via Object > Shading > Caustics cast/receive and a Shadow Caustics toggle on lights. Disabling the cornea's shadow Ray Visibility is the alternative fix for a dark iris. EEVEE Next (4.2+) uses Raytraced Transmission plus a Material Output Thickness socket.
queue.query: Blender manual shadow caustics MNEE cast receive object light settings EEVEE raytraced transmission thickness

queue.claim: Eyelash counts and lengths: about 90-160 upper lashes (8-12 mm) and about 50-80 lower lashes (6-8 mm). Lower tear meniscus height is about 0.2-0.5 mm. The caruncle is about 3-5 mm across.
